title: Welcome to the Jungle Drops Its Trailer Tomorrow. Fifteen Stars. One Franchise. Pure Chaos.
excerpt: Akshay Kumar, Suniel Shetty, and Paresh Rawal reunite for the biggest comedy ensemble Bollywood has fielded in years — and the three-minute trailer is promising absolute madness.
body:
There is exactly one franchise in Bollywood that can put fifteen A-listers in a room and still feel like it needs more. **Welcome to the Jungle** drops its theatrical trailer tomorrow, June 11, at a grand launch event in Mumbai — and if the teaser, the songs, and the sheer audacity of this cast list are anything to go by, the internet is about to have a very good afternoon.

<youtube>https://youtube.com/watch?v=CEfuDgQeROQ</youtube>

Directed by **Ahmed Khan**, the third instalment of the beloved Welcome franchise brings back the trio that made the original a comfort rewatch for an entire generation: **Akshay Kumar**, **Suniel Shetty**, and **Paresh Rawal**. Their chemistry — the deadpan timing, the escalating chaos, the looks that say more than dialogue ever could — is reportedly the centrepiece of a three-minute trailer that sources describe as "loaded with laugh-out-loud moments, funny situations, and one-liners."

> "Akshay Kumar will be seen in top form in the trailer. His camaraderie with Suniel Shetty and Paresh Rawal is one of the biggest highlights and is sure to remind audiences why the trio has always been loved on screen." — Production source to Pinkvilla

But this is a Welcome film, which means the cast list doesn't stop at three. **Arshad Warsi**, **Jacqueline Fernandez**, **Disha Patani**, **Raveena Tandon**, **Lara Dutta**, **Rajpal Yadav**, **Johnny Lever**, **Shreyas Talpade**, **Tusshar Kapoor**, **Jackie Shroff**, and **Aftab Shivdasani** are all in the mix. That's not a cast — that's a small film festival.

The promotional campaign has already been building momentum. The teaser introduced audiences to the film's adventurous jungle backdrop — a departure from the Dubai and gangster settings of the earlier films — and hinted at the larger-than-life comic madness the franchise is known for. The song 'Ucha Lamba Kad Forever,' featuring Akshay and Disha, dropped earlier this month and immediately sent nostalgia levels through the roof, reworking the iconic track from the 2007 original with a fresh, sun-drenched energy.

Ahmed Khan, celebrating his birthday just days before the launch, received a public note from Akshay calling him the only director who "could've pulled off the madness." It's the kind of mutual admiration that either means the film is genuinely special or the PR team is very good. Possibly both.


## Why the Diaspora Should Care

Here's the thing about Welcome films: they travel. The original *Welcome* (2007) and *Welcome Back* (2015) remain among the most-quoted Bollywood comedies in NRI households. They're the films you put on during Diwali when the family is too full to argue about what to watch. They require zero emotional investment, deliver reliable laughs, and feature enough star power to keep three generations entertained.

*Welcome to the Jungle* arrives on June 26, right in the middle of what's shaping up to be Bollywood's most competitive month in years — nine major films, four Fridays, and an estimated ₹1,400 crore on the line. It's going head-to-head with **Cocktail 2** (June 19), **Main Vaapas Aaunga** (June 12), and the re-release of **Lagaan**. The franchise has nostalgia, star power, and the one thing money can't buy: the audience already wants to love it.

The trailer launch tomorrow will be the first real test of whether this instalment can match the lunatic energy of its predecessors. If that three-minute reel delivers even half the chaos this cast promises, June 26 can't come fast enough.

*Welcome to the Jungle releases in theatres on June 26, 2026. The trailer drops tomorrow, June 11, with the full cast in attendance.*
